entries.finding: the kernel mesh (2542 vertices, 5008 triangles, 90 600 bytes) is written by the OCCT harness, parsed by the probe and uploaded to a vertex/index buffer; a scene frame takes 0.755 ms mean, 1.278 ms p99, painted 338 328 of 921 600 pixels

entries.capability: pan, zoom, orbit and DPI move the mesh as expected
entries.finding: orbit +-30 deg leaves the covered fraction at 0.3671 (a sphere is rotationally symmetric, so this is the expected invariance); pan shifts it to 0.3589; zoom 2x fills the frame (1.0) and zoom 0.5x shrinks to 0.0842 (about 1/4 of the base, matching a 1/zoom^2 area law); DPI 1.5x and 2x keep the fraction at 0.3671 while frame time grows with pixel count (0.98 ms, 1.54 ms)

entries.capability: bench of first frame, frame time and GPU memory
entries.finding: minimal 1280x720 loop: device 0.044 s, first frame 29.4 ms, 0.24 ms/frame, 7.4 MB; adapter is an NVIDIA RTX 3060 through Vulkan. The fps figure is a loop measurement, not viewport FPS
